title: Figaro GHG Disclosure Schema v1
description: Off-chain schema definition for the figaro-ghg-disclosure-v1 attestation schema. Defines the disclosure lifecycle, stage encoding, content reference format, and normative basis for GHG reporting in Figaro process graphs.

normativeReferences.title: ISO 14064-1:2018
normativeReferences.description: Specification with guidance at the organization level for quantification and reporting of greenhouse gas emissions and removals.

normativeReferences.title: ISO 14064-3:2019
normativeReferences.description: Specification with guidance for the verification and validation of greenhouse gas statements.

normativeReferences.title: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (Revised Edition)
normativeReferences.description: Requirements and guidance for companies preparing a corporate-level GHG emissions inventory. Defines scope 1, scope 2, and scope 3 categories.

normativeReferences.title: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Accounting and Reporting Standard
normativeReferences.description: Requirements and guidance for scope 3 emissions accounting across the value chain.

0.name: Commitment
0.description: Declaration of intent to disclose process-attributable GHG emissions under this schema. Analogous to ISO 14064-1 §5.1 (GHG inventory planning) — the responsible party commits to the disclosure obligation before economic activity begins.
0.contentRefFormat: keccak256 of 'figaro:ghg:commitment:v1:{role}:{orderHash}' — a deterministic hash binding the commitment to order and role.

1.name: Inventory
1.description: Quantified GHG emissions statement for the order node, expressed in grams CO₂e. Maps to ISO 14064-1 §5.2–5.4 (identification, quantification, and reporting of GHG sources and sinks). The contentRef encodes the emissions value as a uint256 in a bytes32 field.
1.supersessionRule: Latest attestation for the same orderHash and stage supersedes all prior. Per GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Ch. 5 (restatement policy).

2.name: Restatement
2.description: Correction to a previously filed inventory statement. Per GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Ch. 5, restatements are triggered by structural changes, methodology updates, or error discovery. The new value replaces the prior inventory for accounting purposes.
2.contentRefFormat: Same as Inventory — uint256 grams CO₂e encoded as bytes32.
2.supersessionRule: Restatement supersedes the active Inventory value. Multiple restatements chain — latest wins.

3.name: Verification
3.description: Third-party verification or validation statement for the disclosed emissions data. Maps to ISO 14064-3 (verification/validation of GHG statements). The contentRef typically points to an IPFS-pinned verification report or attestation artifact.
3.contentRefFormat: IPFS content hash (CIDv1) encoded as bytes32, or keccak256 of the verification document.

scopeGuidance.description: Figaro GHG disclosure attaches to individual order nodes in a process tree. Each order node represents a specific value-added contribution. The scope classification depends on the relationship between the reporting entity (buyer who opened the boundary) and the responsible party (seller of each order).
scopeGuidance.scope1: Direct emissions from sources owned or controlled by the responsible party during order fulfillment.
scopeGuidance.scope2: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heat, or cooling consumed during order fulfillment.
scopeGuidance.scope3: Other indirect value-chain emissions attributable to the order node but not directly controlled by the responsible party.
scopeGuidance.avoidedEmissions: NOT part of this schema. Comparative or avoided-emissions claims require a separate schema (e.g., figaro-ghg-avoided-v1). See GHG_AVOIDED_EMISSIONS_NOTE.md.

accountingPrinciples.description: Per GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, all disclosures under this schema must adhere to five accounting principles.
accountingPrinciples.relevance: Choose the GHG sources and sinks that appropriately reflect the process being reported.
accountingPrinciples.completeness: Account for all GHG emissions within the chosen reporting boundary.
accountingPrinciples.consistency: Use consistent methodologies to allow meaningful comparison over time.
accountingPrinciples.transparency: Address all relevant issues in a factual and coherent manner.
accountingPrinciples.accuracy: Ensure quantified emissions are not systematically over- or understated.

processTreeBinding.description: This schema binds GHG disclosure to Figaro's process tree model. Each disclosure attaches to a specific orderHash within a processId. The buyer (reporting entity) opens the disclosure boundary; each seller (responsible party) submits their inventory for the order they are fulfilling.
processTreeBinding.orderHashRole: Identifies the specific order node in the process tree. One inventory per order per responsible party.
processTreeBinding.processIdRole: Groups all order-level disclosures into a single process-wide reporting envelope.
processTreeBinding.attesterRole: The address that submitted the attestation — must match the responsible party (seller) for inventory stages, or the reporting entity (buyer) for boundary-level actions.
